subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired and the conflict-resolved exact head passes workflow checks, should the security owners accept these credential-bearing GitHub Action revisions as one grouped update?
rationale: The assertion repair and release-ref verification are mechanical, but accepting replacement third-party executable code in privileged workflows requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve the verified group
options.body: Accept the grouped revisions after guard synchronization, clean merge-result inspection, and green exact-head validation.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, registry, Codex, release, and CodeQL revisions into narrower security-review batches.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Retain the current pins until the privileged revisions can receive adequate review.

recommendation.title: Approve the verified group
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped revisions after guard synchronization, clean merge-result inspection, and green exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This team explicitly owns the security workflows and dependency-guard contracts central to the decision.
